title: Imported Organic Foods -  The Big Lie
summary: Video on an Oregon hazelnut grower's case that USDA group certification lets foreign organic imports skip farm inspections and undercut US farmers.

assertions.quote: the USDA organic label on imported food it doesn't really mean what you think it does
only 2% of the group members are required to be inspected each year by a USDA accredited Sur certifier
Turkish organic hazelnuts were now being sold at rock bottom prices in the US

verdicts.note: OIG says the lack of port controls raises the risk of non-organic imports sold as organic and 'could create an unfair economic environment for U.S. organic producers', which is a stated risk with no price data.

assertions.quote: every single us organic farm gets inspected every year
